title: incident-bot: improve SLO -> Runbook auto-diagnostics linking and retry heuristics
author: Priya Nair
description: Improve incident-bot automated diagnostics by (1) making SLO->Runbook linking more resilient and accurate via fuzzy matching and priority weighting, (2) adding exponential backoff and jitter to runbook fetches to reduce rate-limit flapping against the runbook service, and (3) exposing operational metrics and traces for autodiagnostics. Motivation: during recent oncall rotations we observed missing runbook links for SLO-derived incidents and intermittent failures from the runbook service causing noisy alerts. This change increases link coverage, reduces noisy failures, and surfaces metrics for ongoing tuning. Summary of changes: adds a matcher with configurable weights (title, tags, SLO-id), implements a fetcher with backoff and retry budget, emits autodiag.match_{total,success} and autodiag.fetch_retries counters, adds unit and e2e tests, and updates templates to surface fallback suggestions when an exact runbook isn't found. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag (INCIDENT_AUTODIAG_ENABLED) with telemetry gating; monitor autodiag.match_success and autodiag.fetch_retries for 48h before ramp. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] metrics and traces added [x] feature flag gating [x] docs note in runbooks guide. No public API changes.
commits: feat: add autodiagnostics matcher with fuzzy weighting

release_notes: Enhances incident-bot autodiagnostics: better SLO->runbook linking via weighted fuzzy matcher, added exponential backoff for runbook fetches, and new telemetry (autodiag.match_total, autodiag.match_success, autodiag.fetch_retries). Feature gated; no external API changes.

Marta Lopez: fetcher retry budget seems conservative; suggest increasing maxRetries from 3 to 5 for transient runbook service errors.
Priya Nair: updated backoff and added jitter config; default kept at 4 retries behind feature flag.
Jordan Fields: validated e2e smoke locally; observed reduced noisy failures when runbook service returned 503s, approving.
Ethan Kim: approving after CI rerun (integration flake resolved).
changelog_summary: incident-bot: improve SLO->runbook auto-diagnostics linking and add resilient fetcher with metrics
notes_for_ops: Feature gated via INCIDENT_AUTODIAG_ENABLED=false by default. Recommended ramp: enable for 10% of traffic for 2h, 50% for 12h, then 100% after stability. Monitor autodiag.match_success (>95%) and autodiag.fetch_retries for spikes.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover matcher scoring and fallback; integration test simulates runbook service 5xx to validate backoff; e2e smoke script validated rendering of fallback suggestions in UI. CI had one flaky integration test initially, re-run passed.
